obligations.text: This is Accepted/Planned; delivery and qualification require separate evidence.
Declared target pre-tag checks are required.
A failed declared check blocks the affected candidate or publication; it must not become a warning.
This supersedes only ADR-0040's advisory treatment of release-skill pre-tag proof.
Its independent per-target release behavior and other advisory checks retain their separately applicable decisions and later successors.
The checks retain their existing declared-input, check-only, content-binding and clean-tree contracts.
Success grants no merge or publication authority and establishes no unrelated installed-host qualification.
Declared targets, candidate preflight, the release owner and generated guidance must agree that these checks are required.
Correct failing inputs or checks without silently removing the gate.
Preserve its actual failure and repair the owning implementation; bookkeeping success is not release evidence.
